subject.title: fix(ui): sidebar section chevrons after labels, collapsed-only counts

question: Should the protected maintainer UI direction—show numeric section counts only while collapsed—be accepted consistently for both ordinary session sections and native-session catalogs?
rationale: The patch applies a deliberate presentation policy across two header implementations; the `maintainer` label requires an explicit human decision rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Accept collapsed-only counts
options.body: Confirm that counts should be hidden while rows are visible and retained only as a collapsed-section summary across all sidebar catalog types.

options.title: Keep expanded counts for selected catalogs
options.body: Specify any catalog or error-state exception that needs a different information-density rule before this branch is merged.

recommendation.title: Accept collapsed-only counts
recommendation.body: Confirm that counts should be hidden while rows are visible and retained only as a collapsed-section summary across all sidebar catalog types.
